# SI015 — raw-numeric-confidence-compared

Confidence must be a coarse band, not a raw number.

## Why

A 0-100 confidence routinely moves by several points between honest validators, which breaks strict equality.

## Bad

```python
return {"confidence": 87}
```

## Good

```python
return {"confidence": "HIGH"}
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI015 -- reason
```
